items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: And we had the son of Bowles was a drummer, he was singin'.

ctx.x: How you met him, how you got involved, and what, the whole deal.

Well, that Harry Carney deal, see, came in from me broadcastin' three days a week with Curl, see. And we were doing mostly technical solo work, I mean, it wasn't so much jazz much, it was semi-classical stuff. I give you an idea - I was playin' things like "Nola" on the saxophone, alto, and Curl was playin' some of those things that he learned in school, I mean those classical trumpet solos, you know, triple tongue, double tongue, all that stuff.
